definitions.explanation: A sharp blade used for shaving hair from the face or body. Can refer to traditional straight razors or modern safety razors.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}かみそりで{剃|そ}る。
examples.english: I shave with an electric razor.

examples.japanese: かみそりの{刃|は}を{交換|こうかん}する。
かみそりで{手|て}を{切|き}ってしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally cut my hand with a razor.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {剃刀|かみそり} in kanji, but hiragana かみそり is much more common in everyday use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気|でんき}かみそり: electric razor/shaver
- かみそりの{刃|は}: razor blade
- かみそり{負|ま}け: razor burn (skin irritation from shaving)
- {使|つか}い{捨|す}てかみそり: disposable razor
- かみそりで{剃|そ}る: to shave with a razor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シェーバー: shaver (loanword, usually for electric razors)
- T{字|じ}かみそり: safety razor (T-shaped)

CULTURAL NOTE:
At Japanese {理髪店|りはつてん} (barbershops), a straight razor shave ({顔剃|かおそ}り) is a standard part of the service. {床屋|とこや} (barbers) are licensed to use straight razors, whereas {美容室|びようしつ} (beauty salons) traditionally are not.
